name: delve-mapper
description: Grid dungeon map editor plugin for Obsidian

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.js --bundle --format=cjs --platform=browser --target=es2020 --external:obsidian --loader:.html=text --outfile=dist/main.js && cp manifest.json styles.css dist/
scripts.deploy: npm run build && mkdir -p "$HOME/The Luggage/.obsidian/plugins/delve-mapper" && cp dist/* "$HOME/The Luggage/.obsidian/plugins/delve-mapper/"

author: Austin
